doc.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Monk proposes a Part II and thanks Lewis.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: If we come back to New York, will you join us for Part II of your story?

That’s great. That’s just, you told us some absolutely wonderful things. And on behalf of the college, I’d really like to thank you for your time, and I hope we can get together again, because you’re just marvelous.
